About.subtitle: A short story of me.
About.bio1: I am a Computer and Information Engineering graduate with a profound passion for software development. I specialize in Full Stack technologies (such as TypeScript, React, Node.js, and various databases) alongside modern web ecosystems. My core focus is on building fast, secure, and user-centric web applications with highly maintainable codebases for long-term scalability.
About.bio2: Throughout my learning and professional journey, I have gained hands-on experience developing real-world projects that solve complex problems and deliver tangible business value at an enterprise level. I am highly accustomed to collaborating within fast-paced, cross-functional teams—whether it is communicating with stakeholders, conducting code reviews to maintain system standards, or brainstorming to find optimal solutions together. Consistently driven by "the challenge of solving complex problems," I place a premium on Clean Code and flexible system architecture that aligns with both exceptional user experiences and business growth.
About.bio3: As a highly motivated fresh graduate, I am fully prepared and eager to launch my professional career. I am currently seeking opportunities as a Software Engineer or Full Stack Developer to leverage my in-depth technical knowledge, analytical problem-solving skills, and adaptability to emerging technologies. I am committed to being a strong asset to your team, helping to innovate, deliver high-quality software, and drive scalable solutions that create true, positive impact for your organization.

Footer.desc: I'm open for freelance projects and full-time opportunities. Feel free to email me to see how can we collaborate.
